The `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` was caused by configuring the Keystore key in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r2/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L25-L28) with `setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`. Because user authentication was enforced at the Keystore level but the user had not authenticated via lock screen / biometrics when saving the token, `Cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key())` failed.

### Changes Made

In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r2/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt):
1. **Disabled User Authentication Requirement**: Updated `KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder` to use `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)` and removed `setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`.
2. **Replaced Incompatible Pre-existing Keys**: Checked if an existing cached Keystore entry was created with `isUserAuthenticationRequired == true` (or failed during cipher initialization), deleting and regenerating it with the new parameters so previous runs won't continue throwing the exception.
3. **Graceful Error Handling in `load()`**: Added a try-catch block around decryption in `load()` to return `null` instead of throwing unhandled exceptions if stored ciphertext or key state is invalid.
